name: Kronos
description: Titan Lord of Time and King of Titans who overthrew Ouranos with an adamantine scythe.

name: Atlas
role_in_series: General of the Titan Army in Book 3. Tricks Artemis into holding the sky until Percy forces Atlas back under the weight.
description: Elder Titan of Endurance and Astronomy. Father of Zoë Nightshade and Calypso. Condemned to hold up the sky.

name: Hyperion
role_in_series: Titan general who commands Kronos's vanguard forces during the Battle of Manhattan. Defeated by Percy and Grover's nature magic.
prison_location: Central Park (turned into a maple tree)
description: Elder Titan of Light and the East. Encased in blazing golden armor; turned into a large maple tree by Grover Underwood's satyr song.

name: Iapetus
role_in_series: Attacks Percy and Thalia in the Underworld in The Demigod Files. After falling into the River Lethe, loses his memory and becomes friendly janitor 'Bob'.
description: Elder Titan of Mortality ('The Piercer'). Memory-wiped by the River Lethe in The Demigod Files and renamed 'Bob'.

name: Oceanus
role_in_series: Leads the underwater campaign against Poseidon's realm in Book 5, forcing Poseidon to defend his palace instead of helping Olympus.
description: Elder Titan of the Ocean. Has a bull-horned head and fish-tail body. Retreated into the deep ocean after Kronos fell.

name: Prometheus
role_in_series: Serves as parley envoy for Kronos in Book 5. Offers Percy Pandora's Jar (Elpis) to surrender Manhattan.
description: Younger Titan of Forethought who gave fire to mankind. Sided cautiously with Kronos in V1 as a diplomat.

name: Koios
role_in_series: Mentioned as escaping Tartarus during Kronos's rise.
description: Elder Titan of Intellect and the North ('Polus'). Grandfather of Apollo and Artemis.

name: Krios
role_in_series: Guarded Mount Othrys in San Francisco while Atlas and Kronos marched east.
description: Elder Titan of Constellations and the South. Wears ram horn armor.

name: Rhea
role_in_series: Mother of the original 6 Olympians who tricked Kronos with a wrapped stone to save baby Zeus.
description: Elder Titaness of Motherhood and Queen of Titans. Saved Zeus from Kronos.
